meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的开发计划自动执行完,留下改动证据与独立工作副本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已把开发计划写成文件,想让它被稳妥地自动执行。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your dev plan is already written down and you want it carried out automatically.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成调度员:它读取 .omo/plans 里的工作计划,把每个复选框拆成小任务派给并行的子代理执行,自己只维护 .omo/ 下的进度状态、证据记录和工作树,不亲自改代码。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-execute”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发;若没有可选计划,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成一份再开始执行。

say.note: 先读取计划并建立进度状态
每个阶段完成后开一个 PR
PR 合并前一直盯 CI 和评审

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it reads a written plan under .omo/plans, splits each checkbox into small tasks, and dispatches them to parallel subagents. It only keeps .omo/ state (Boulder, evidence ledger, worktrees) and never edits code itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans. With no selectable plan, it first calls ulw-plan to generate one.

say_en.note: Reads the plan and sets up progress state
Watches CI and review until merged
